name: @coss-sv/docs
description: The documentation and registry site for COSS for Svelte.

scripts.registry:build: pnpm registry:generate && tsx scripts/registry/build.mts && pnpm registry:check
scripts.test:browser: vitest run --config vitest.browser.config.ts && vitest run --config tests/docs/vitest.d5.browser.config.ts && vitest run --config tests/docs/vitest.d5.reduced-motion.browser.config.ts
scripts.test:unit: pnpm docs:compile && vitest run && pnpm test:browser && pnpm registry:test
scripts.test:e2e: node tests/site/command-menu.browser.mjs && node tests/site/docs-shell.browser.mjs && node tests/site/preview-card.browser.mjs && node tests/site/preview-runtime.browser.mjs && node tests/site/d7-overlays.browser.mjs && node tests/docs/d5-controls.preview.browser.mjs && node tests/docs/d9-navigation.preview.browser.mjs
